meta.subject: fix more cc_pitch cbuf read bug

en.summary: This commit fixes additional CSC cc_pitch read alignment bugs by suppressing no-jump shift underflow and by restoring dummy-line updates in the response shift counters.
why_it_counts: It changes only CSC datapath RTL in the image read path.
The modified logic directly computes read-data shift amounts and response shift-counter evolution.
The commit message explicitly says it fixes a CBUF read bug.
evidence: The no-jump shift path now returns zero when pixel_w_cnt_plus1_d1 is less than or equal to dat_req_pipe_bytes instead of always subtracting.
The patch restores dat_dummy_l0_en through dat_dummy_l3_en handling in rsp_sft_cnt_l*_w.
Both changes are inside NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v and affect image read alignment rather than debug output.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A buffered image-read path often concatenates fetched entry data and then shifts away low bytes that are not part of the current pixel window. That shift should happen only when the fetch returned more bytes than the current consumption window actually needs. If the implementation always computes shift as consumed minus fetched, no-jump cases with equal or fewer fetched bytes underflow the shift amount. Separately, dummy-line or padding cycles still need to update any rolling shift-position counters modulo the entry width; skipping that update lets subsequent responses start from the wrong byte position.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: read-data shift amount and rolling shift-counter maintenance
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Image reads use cc_pitch or similar packed stride cases where some cycles do not require a jump read and fetched bytes are less than or equal to needed bytes, especially when dummy-line events also occur.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Reintroduce unconditional subtraction in the no-jump shift path or stop applying the dummy-line modulo update to the response shift counter.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: allow shift-underflow or drop dummy-line counter update
portability_notes: Target a path that reconstructs pixels from buffered entry reads and tracks a byte or element shift position across cycles.
This bug is portable even if the design uses words, lanes, or elements instead of bytes, as long as a rolling offset is maintained.
Either mutation is grounded in the real patch, but combining both most faithfully restores the original fault surface.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the shift-amount logic for the no-jump image-read case.
Remove the guard that forces shift zero when fetched bytes are less than or equal to the bytes needed, so the design subtracts unconditionally.
Locate the rolling shift-position counter update for dummy or padding responses and remove the dummy-specific modulo-update branch.
Keep the rest of the read/shift pipeline unchanged so the resulting misalignment propagates into output data.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CSC no-jump read-data shift computation and rsp_sft_cnt_l0/l1/l2/l3 maintenance
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix guards the no-jump shift calculation so it is zero when no extra low-byte removal is needed, and it restores the dat_dummy_l* update path in the per-line response shift counters.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v, collapse the guarded no-jump shift logic back to a plain subtraction and remove the dat_dummy_l0_en/dat_dummy_l1_en/dat_dummy_l2_en/dat_dummy_l3_en branches from rsp_sft_cnt_l*_w.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Image data from CBUF is shifted by the wrong amount, especially after cc_pitch and dummy-line scenarios, causing byte-lane misalignment and corrupted pixel windows.
evidence_for_injection: The changed expressions directly control sc2buf_dat_rd_shift_w and rsp_sft_cnt_l*_w, both of which are alignment-critical datapath signals.
The new guard explicitly separates greater-than and less-or-equal cases, which is characteristic of a real underflow fix.
The dummy-line branches were previously commented out and are restored by the fix, giving a precise reverse mutation.
notes: If only one mutation is desired, restoring the unconditional no-jump subtraction is the stronger cross-DUT pattern.
Keeping both mutations gives the closest source-grounded reinjection.

zh.summary: 该提交通过抑制无 jump 场景下的 shift 下溢，并恢复 dummy line 对响应 shift 计数器的更新，修复了 CSC 在 cc_pitch 情况下的额外读对齐错误。
why_it_counts: 它只修改了图像读取路径中的 CSC 数据通路 RTL。
被修改的逻辑直接计算读数据 shift 量以及响应 shift 计数器的推进方式。
提交信息明确说明是在修复 CBUF read bug。
evidence: 无 jump 的 shift 路径现在在 pixel_w_cnt_plus1_d1 小于等于 dat_req_pipe_bytes 时返回零，而不是始终做减法。
补丁恢复了 rsp_sft_cnt_l*_w 中 dat_dummy_l0_en 到 dat_dummy_l3_en 的处理分支。
这两处都位于 NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v 中，作用于图像读取对齐，而非调试输出。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 带缓冲的图像读取路径通常会先拼接多个 entry 数据，再把不属于当前像素窗口的低位字节移走。只有当本次抓取返回的数据多于当前真正需要的数据时，才应该进行这种移位。如果实现始终把 shift 计算成 consumed 减 fetched，那么在无 jump 且 fetched 小于等于 needed 的情况下就会出现下溢。另一方面，dummy line 或 padding 周期依然需要按 entry 宽度更新滚动 shift 位置计数器；如果跳过这一步，后续真实响应就会从错误的字节位置开始。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 读数据移位量计算与滚动 shift 计数维护
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 图像读取采用 cc_pitch 或类似紧凑 stride，某些周期不需要 jump read 且 fetched bytes 小于等于 needed bytes，尤其同时伴随 dummy line 事件时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 重新引入无 jump 路径的无条件减法，或停止在 dummy-line 情况下对响应 shift 计数器进行模 entry 更新。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: allow shift-underflow or drop dummy-line counter update
portability_notes: 应定位到从 buffer entry 重构像素数据、并跨周期维护字节或元素偏移的位置。
即使目标设计按 word、lane 或 element 计数，只要维护了滚动偏移，这个故障机理也成立。
两个变更都来自真实补丁；若同时恢复，更接近原始故障面。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位无 jump 图像读取情况下的 shift 量计算逻辑。
删除当 fetched bytes 小于等于 needed bytes 时强制 shift 为零的保护条件，让设计重新无条件做减法。
找到 dummy 或 padding 响应时的滚动 shift 位置计数更新逻辑，删除 dummy 专用的模更新分支。
保持其余读/移位流水不变，使错位自然传播到输出数据。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CSC 无 jump 读数据 shift 计算以及 rsp_sft_cnt_l0/l1/l2/l3 维护逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复为无 jump 的 shift 计算增加了保护条件，在不需要丢弃低字节时强制 shift 为零，并恢复了每条子线响应 shift 计数器中的 dat_dummy_l* 更新路径。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 NV_NVDLA_CSC_dl.v 中，把带保护的无 jump shift 逻辑退回为简单减法，并移除 rsp_sft_cnt_l*_w 中的 dat_dummy_l0_en/dat_dummy_l1_en/dat_dummy_l2_en/dat_dummy_l3_en 分支。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 来自 CBUF 的图像数据会按错误的偏移量移位，尤其在 cc_pitch 和 dummy-line 场景后出现字节 lane 错位和像素窗口损坏。
evidence_for_injection: 补丁直接修改了 sc2buf_dat_rd_shift_w 和 rsp_sft_cnt_l*_w，这两个都是对齐关键数据通路信号。
新增的条件分支显式区分大于与小于等于的情况，这很符合真实下溢修复的形态。
dummy-line 分支此前处于注释状态，补丁把它恢复回来，因此逆向注入点非常明确。
notes: 如果只做一个变异，恢复无 jump 路径的无条件减法是更强的跨 DUT 模式。
若同时恢复两处变化，则更贴近源仓库中的原始故障。
